CREATE TYPE boundary_prefix AS (a integer,b integer,c integer); CREATE VIEW boundary_prefix_value AS SELECT '(16909060,84281096,287454020)'::boundary_prefix AS v; CREATE VIEW boundary_prefix_null AS SELECT '(16909060,84281096,)'::boundary_prefix AS v
PREPARE boundary_fields AS SELECT (v).a, (v).b FROM boundary_prefix_value; EXECUTE boundary_fields
ALTER TYPE boundary_prefix ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE bigint
SELECT (v).a, (v).b FROM boundary_prefix_value
SELECT v IS NULL AS n, v IS NOT NULL AS nn, (v).c IS NULL AS tail_null FROM boundary_prefix_value
SELECT v::text FROM boundary_prefix_value WHERE false
SELECT CASE WHEN false THEN v::text ELSE 'unread' END FROM boundary_prefix_value
EXECUTE boundary_fields
SELECT (v).a = 361984551007945476 AS a, (v).b = 287454020 AS b FROM boundary_prefix_value
SELECT v IS NULL AS n, v IS NOT NULL AS nn, (v).c IS NULL AS tail_null FROM boundary_prefix_null
SELECT (v).a, (v).c FROM boundary_prefix_null
BEGIN; SAVEPOINT boundary_restore; ALTER TYPE boundary_prefix ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE integer; SELECT v::text FROM boundary_prefix_value
ROLLBACK TO boundary_restore; SELECT (v).a, (v).b FROM boundary_prefix_value; ROLLBACK

CREATE TYPE boundary_nullable AS (a integer); CREATE VIEW boundary_nullable_value AS SELECT '()'::boundary_nullable AS v; ALTER TYPE boundary_nullable ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE bigint; SELECT v::text, v IS NULL AS n FROM boundary_nullable_value
SELECT '(4,5,6)'::boundary_prefix::text
SELECT (v).a, (v).b, v IS NOT NULL AS nn FROM boundary_prefix_value
SELECT (v).a, (v).c FROM boundary_prefix_null
SELECT v::text, v IS NULL AS n FROM boundary_nullable_value
ALTER TYPE boundary_prefix ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE integer; SELECT v::text FROM boundary_prefix_value; SELECT v::text FROM boundary_prefix_null
DROP VIEW boundary_prefix_value, boundary_prefix_null, boundary_nullable_value; DROP TYPE boundary_prefix, boundary_nullable
